papers.title: Skeletal stem cell and bone implant interactions are enhanced by LASER titanium modification.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the osteo-regenerative potential of Titanium (Ti) modified by Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation (LASER) beam (Yb-YAG) upon culture with human Skeletal Stem Cells (hSSCs(1)). METHODS: Human skeletal cell populations were isolated from the bone marrow of haematologically normal patients undergoing primary total hip replacement following appropriate consent. STRO-1(+) hSSC(1) function was examined for 10 days across four groups using Ti discs: i) machined Ti surface group in basal media (Mb(2)), ii) machined Ti surface group in osteogenic media (Mo(3)), iii) LASER-modified Ti group in basal media (Lb(4)) and, iv) LASER-modified Ti group in osteogenic media (Lo(5)). Molecular analysis and qRT-PCR as well as functional analysis including biochemistry (DNA, Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP(6)) specific activity), live/dead immunostaining (Cell Tracker Green (CTG(7))/Ethidium Homodimer-1 (EH-1(8))), and fluorescence staining (for vinculin and phalloidin) were undertaken. Inverted, confocal and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) approaches were used to characterise cell adherence, proliferation, and phenotype. RESULTS: Enhanced cell spreading and morphological rearrangement, including focal adhesions were observed following culture of hSSCs(1) on LASER surfaces in both basal and osteogenic conditions. Biochemical analysis demonstrated enhanced ALP(6) specific activity on the hSSCs(1)-seeded on LASER-modified surface in basal culture media. Molecular analysis demonstrated enhanced ALP(6) and osteopontin expression on titanium LASER treated surfaces in basal conditions. SEM, inverted microscopy and confocal laser scanning microscopy confirmed extensive proliferation and migration of human bone marrow stromal cells on all surfaces evaluated. CONCLUSIONS: LASER-modified Ti surfaces modify the behaviour of hSSCs.(1) In particular, SSC(1) adhesion, osteogenic gene expression, cell morphology and cytoskeleton structure were affected. The current studies show Ti LASER modification can enhance the osseointegration between Ti and skeletal cells, with important implications for orthopaedic application.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛表面改性以增强骨整合，但未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或力学测试，与研究路线不相关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no stress shielding or fatigue analysis, no mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光改性钛表面如何增强骨骼干细胞与植入物的整合。
summary_zh.method: 用Yb-YAG激光处理钛盘，培养人骨骼干细胞并通过多种分析评估细胞行为。
summary_zh.result: 激光表面促进细胞铺展、黏附、碱性磷酸酶活性和成骨基因表达。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验，包括生化、分子和显微成像验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the osteo-regenerative potential of LASER-modified titanium surfaces for enhancing skeletal stem cell integration.
summary_en.method: Human skeletal stem cells were cultured on machined or LASER-treated titanium discs under basal or osteogenic media, assessed via biochemical assays, qRT-PCR, and microscopy.
summary_en.result: LASER surfaces enhanced cell spreading, focal adhesions, alkaline phosphatase activity, and osteogenic gene expression (ALP, osteopontin) compared to machined surfaces.
summary_en.validation: In vitro validation using human skeletal stem cells with live/dead staining, SEM, confocal microscopy, and biochemical/molecular analyses.

papers.title: Automatic LQR Tuning Based on Gaussian Process Global Optimization
papers.abstract: This paper proposes an automatic controller tuning framework based on linear optimal control combined with Bayesian optimization. With this framework, an initial set of controller gains is automatically improved according to a pre-defined performance objective evaluated from experimental data. The underlying Bayesian optimization algorithm is Entropy Search, which represents the latent objective as a Gaussian process and constructs an explicit belief over the location of the objective minimum. This is used to maximize the information gain from each experimental evaluation. Thus, this framework shall yield improved controllers with fewer evaluations compared to alternative approaches. A seven-degree-of-freedom robot arm balancing an inverted pole is used as the experimental demonstrator. Results of a two- and four-dimensional tuning problems highlight the method's potential for automatic controller tuning on robotic platforms.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及机器人控制器调参，与FEA替代模型和生物力学设计方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on automatic controller tuning for robotics, with no FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification in simulation-based design, and no transferability to implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 自动调优线性二次型调节器参数以减少实验次数
summary_zh.method: 基于熵搜索的贝叶斯优化框架，用高斯过程建模目标函数
summary_zh.result: 在七自由度机器人倒立摆系统中实现了高效调参
summary_zh.validation: 在真实机器人平台上进行实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Develop an automatic framework to tune LQR controller gains efficiently using Bayesian optimization to minimize experimental evaluations.
summary_en.method: Use Entropy Search, a Bayesian optimization algorithm that models the latent objective with a Gaussian process to maximize information gain per evaluation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrated faster convergence and improved controller performance in two- and four-dimensional tuning problems on a real robot arm balancing an inverted pole.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation on a seven-degree-of-freedom robot arm with an inverted pole balancing task.
